name: word-roller-wave
title: Word Roller Wave
description: A word is built from letters that rise one after another from below as they fade in, and leave by lifting out in a ripple, before the next word starts; the last word stays.
useWhen: A fixed lead-in with a changing word where the swap should read as a wave across the letters.
A lively title (design, develop, deploy, delight) on a light background.
avoidWhen: The letters of a single phrase rise once: use per-character-rise.
Words that must stay perfectly still between swaps.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the word in pixels. A wide line shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: How long each word is shown, in 30 fps frames.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
